The supreme day of the entire pilgrimage: The supreme day of the entire pilgrimage. The Prophet ﷺ declared: "Hajj is Arafah." Pilgrims stand before Allah with open hands and weeping eyes, begging for forgiveness and mercy until the sun sets, then proceed peacefully to Muzdalifah.
Move to the plains of Arafah after sunri: Move to the plains of Arafah after sunrise. Settle into the camps before solar noon (Zawal).
Listen to the Arafah sermon at Masjid Na: Listen to the Arafah sermon at Masjid Namirah (or broadcast in camp), then combine and shorten Dhuhr and Asr at Dhuhr time.
Spend from midday until sunset standing: Spend from midday until sunset standing or sitting facing the Qibla, raising hands continuously in supplication and repentance. Presence within Arafah boundaries is essential.
After the sun sets completely, leave Ara: After the sun sets completely, leave Arafah for Muzdalifah with calmness and composure without praying Maghrib at Arafah.
Upon arrival at Muzdalifah, combine Magh: Upon arrival at Muzdalifah, combine Maghrib (3) and Isha (shortened to 2) with one adhan and two iqamahs.
Collect pebble stones (chickpea-sized) f: Collect pebble stones (chickpea-sized) for stoning the Jamarat (at least 7 for tomorrow, or 49/70 for all days). Rest under the open sky until Fajr.

Ensure you remain strictly inside the bo: Ensure you remain strictly inside the boundary signs of Arafah until after sunset.
Do not rush during the transit to Muzdal: Do not rush during the transit to Muzdalifah; practice patience amid heavy bus queues.
The most action-packed day of Hajj. Pilg: The most action-packed day of Hajj. Pilgrims stone the Big Jamarah, perform animal sacrifice, shave or trim hair to achieve the first Tahallul, and travel to Makkah for the pivotal Tawaf al-Ifadah and Sa'i.
Pray Fajr at dawn in Muzdalifah, stand f: Pray Fajr at dawn in Muzdalifah, stand facing Qibla making dua until just before sunrise, then proceed to Mina.
Stone the largest pillar with 7 pebbles: Stone the largest pillar with 7 pebbles one by one, saying "Allahu Akbar" with each throw. Cease Talbiyah with the first pebble.
Slaughter sacrificial livestock (or purc: Slaughter sacrificial livestock (or purchase authorized official voucher via Adahi/Islamic Development Bank).
Men shave head completely or trim evenly: Men shave head completely or trim evenly; women trim fingertip length. All Ihram prohibitions lifted EXCEPT marital relations.
Proceed to Al-Masjid Al-Haram to perform: Proceed to Al-Masjid Al-Haram to perform Tawaf al-Ifadah (major Hajj pillar) and Sa'i. With this, Tahallul al-Akbar is achieved (all prohibitions lifted).
Return to Mina before midnight to spend: Return to Mina before midnight to spend the night in the tents.
The order of rites on the 10th (Stoning: The order of rites on the 10th (Stoning → Sacrifice → Haircut → Tawaf) is Sunnah, but if done out of sequence, the Prophet ﷺ permitted it with: "Do it, and there is no harm" (Bukhari).
Wear regular clothes after shaving/trimm: Wear regular clothes after shaving/trimming before proceeding to Makkah for Tawaf al-Ifadah.
The Prophet ﷺ said: \"The days of Tashre: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The days of Tashreeq are days of eating, drinking, and remembrance of Allah." Pilgrims stone all three Jamarat after midday each day. Those wishing to depart early may leave Mina before sunset on the 12th.

After stoning the Small and Medium Jamar: After stoning the Small and Medium Jamarat, step to the side facing the Qibla and make long, heartfelt personal du'a.
Spend the majority of the night within t: Spend the majority of the night within the boundaries of Mina.
Pilgrims choosing early departure may ex: Pilgrims choosing early departure may exit Mina before sunset on the 12th after completing the stoning.
Stoning before Zawal is not permitted ac: Stoning before Zawal is not permitted according to the majority of scholars; wait until the call to Dhuhr prayer before proceeding.

For pilgrims who stay the 13th (Ta'akhkh: For pilgrims who stay the 13th (Ta'akhkhur), they stone the three Jamarat one last time after midday. Before leaving Makkah to return home, all pilgrims perform the Farewell Tawaf (Tawaf al-Wida') as their final act in the sacred city.
Stone all three pillars after Zawal (21: Stone all three pillars after Zawal (21 pebbles), gaining greater spiritual reward as mentioned in Quran (2:203).
Pack belongings and leave Mina permanent: Pack belongings and leave Mina permanently for Makkah.
Circumambulate the Kaaba 7 times immedia: Circumambulate the Kaaba 7 times immediately before departing Makkah. No Sa'i is required. Women in menses or postpartum bleeding are exempt.
O Allah, this is Your House and I am You: O Allah, this is Your House and I am Your servant. You carried me upon that which You subjected for me of Your creation, so do not let this be the last time I visit Your Sacred House.
Pack all bags and finalize hotel checkou: Pack all bags and finalize hotel checkout before Tawaf al-Wida' so you can depart directly to the airport or train station.

Men wear two seamless white sheets (Izar: Men wear two seamless white sheets (Izar wrapped around waist, Rida draped over shoulders). Head must remain uncovered.
Women wear modest, loose regular clothin: Women wear modest, loose regular clothing of any color, leaving the face and hands uncovered (no niqab or gloves in Ihram).
Formulate the Niyyah (intention): \"Labb: Formulate the Niyyah (intention): "Labbayk Allahumma Umrah" (لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ عُمْرَةً).

Prohibitions in Ihram: No perfume, no cu: Prohibitions in Ihram: No perfume, no cutting hair or nails, no marital intimacy, no hunting, no stitched clothing conforming to limbs for men.
Arriving at the Grand Mosque in Makkah w: Arriving at the Grand Mosque in Makkah with humility, awe, and reverence. Step in with the right foot and supplicate for Allah's infinite mercy.
Stop reciting the Talbiyah upon reaching: Stop reciting the Talbiyah upon reaching the Kaaba.
Enter the Mosque with the right foot fir: Enter the Mosque with the right foot first and say the standard mosque entrance dua.
When gazing upon the Kaaba for the first: When gazing upon the Kaaba for the first time, raise hands and make heartfelt du'a — this is a moment when supplications are answered.
O Allah, You are Peace and from You is p: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace, so greet us our Lord with peace. O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
Circumambulating the Holy Kaaba seven co: Circumambulating the Holy Kaaba seven complete times in a state of ritual purity (Wudu), beginning and ending at the Black Stone (Hajar al-Aswad) with the Kaaba on your left.
Purity (Wudu) is an obligatory condition: Purity (Wudu) is an obligatory condition for Tawaf according to majority of scholars.

Start in line with the Black Stone (mark: Start in line with the Black Stone (marked by green light on the Haram wall). Point the right hand towards it and recite: "Bismillahi Allahu Akbar" (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ).
Men perform Ramal (رَمَل): A brisk walk: Men perform Ramal (رَمَل): A brisk walk with short quick paces during the first 3 circuits, followed by normal walking in the remaining 4 circuits.
Supplicate freely during circumambulatio: Supplicate freely during circumambulation; there are no fixed words except between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone.
Touch the Yemeni Corner (Rukn al-Yamani): Touch the Yemeni Corner (Rukn al-Yamani) with the right hand without kissing if accessible, otherwise pass without pointing.
After the 7th circuit: Cover both should: After the 7th circuit: Cover both shoulders (end Idtiba'). Pray 2 Rak'ahs behind Maqam Ibrahim (or anywhere in the Haram), reciting Surah al-Kafirun in the 1st rak'ah and Surah al-Ikhlas in the 2nd.
Drink Zamzam water from the dispensers,: Drink Zamzam water from the dispensers, make du'a, and pour some over your head.

Avoid pushing, shoving, or attempting to: Avoid pushing, shoving, or attempting to kiss the Black Stone if it causes harm to fellow worshippers.
Walking seven laps between the hillocks: Walking seven laps between the hillocks of Safa and Marwah, commemorating the devotion of Lady Hajar (peace be upon her) as she sought water for infant Ismail.
Approach Mount Safa. As you near it, rec: Approach Mount Safa. As you near it, recite the Quranic verse (2:158) and declare: "Abda'u bima bada'allahu bih" (I begin with that which Allah began with).
Ascend Safa, face the Kaaba, raise your: Ascend Safa, face the Kaaba, raise your hands, and recite the prophetic takbir and declaration of tawheed 3 times with personal du'a in between.
Walk towards Marwah. When reaching the g: Walk towards Marwah. When reaching the green fluorescent markers, men run at a brisk jog, while women maintain their normal walking pace.
Upon reaching Marwah, face the Kaaba and: Upon reaching Marwah, face the Kaaba and repeat the same remembrance and supplication as on Safa.
